title: Ingingo z'ubufasha
intro: Ibisubizo bigufi ku ikoreshwa ry'iyi porogaramu. Si inama z'ubuvuzi.

reviewed.question: 'Byasuzumwe' bisobanura iki?
reviewed.answer: Umwe mu bagize itsinda rikwitaho yarebye igisubizo. Porogaramu yerekana gusa ibisubizo itsinda rikwitaho ryasuzumye.

latestCheck.question: Kuki ntabona isuzuma ryanjye riheruka?
latestCheck.answer: Isuzuma rishya rigaragara nyuma y'uko itsinda rikwitaho ririsuzumye. Kugeza icyo gihe, Amateka yerekana ko rigitegerejwe.

stopReminders.question: Nahagarika nte kwibutswa?
stopReminders.answer: Fungura Kwibutswa, hanyuma Igenamiterere ryo kwibutswa, uzimye kwibutswa. Ushobora kongera kubifungura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

demoPersona.question: Umuntu w'igerageza ni iki?
demoPersona.answer: Umuntu w'igerageza ni umuntu w'impimbano ushobora gukoresha ugerageza iyi porogaramu. Si ukwinjira nyakuri, kandi nta makuru n'amwe ari ay'ukuri.

correction.question: Nasaba nte gukosora?
correction.answer: Niba hari ikintu kiri mu makuru yawe gisa n'ikitari cyo, ushobora gusaba itsinda rikwitaho kukigenzura. Gusaba ntibihindura amakuru yawe.
